notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for final-federate resignation cleanup and object-name reuse. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies final-federate NO_ACTION cleanup, rejoin, object-name reservation, named registration reuse, identity round trips, federation destruction, disconnect, and standard reservation callback behavior without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador final-federate resignation, object identity, object-name reservation, named registration, federation destruction, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador reservation callback
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador final-federate cleanup and object-name lifecycle declarations
